title: Supported splitting prescribed by a derived coefficient projection
statement: Use the finite coefficient datum $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], the actual pro-etale derived operations of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], the supported groups of [def-pur-support-cohomology], and the normalized supported-Hom identifications and closed-support transport of [lem-pur-supported-hom] and [lem-pur-supported-hom-pullback]. Write $U_S=A_S$ in the coefficient-unit coordinates of [thm-pur-projective-bundle-formula]. Given a scheme map $f:T'\to T$, closed immersions $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$ and $i':Z'\hookrightarrow T'$, $K\in D^+(T,A)$, $b\in\mathbf Z$, and a predicate $C$ on arrows $\rho:Rf_*U_{T'}\to U_T$, define the prescribed supported projection splitting predicate as follows. There are normalized identifications $\chi,\chi'$ and canonical closed-support transport $e$, an arrow $\rho$ with $C(\rho)$, an arrow $r_K:Rf_*Lf^*K\to K$, and an additive map $s:H^b_{Z'}(T',f^*K)\to H^b_Z(T,K)$. They satisfy $\pi\,Rf_*(\mu_{Lf^*K})\,r_K=(\rho\otimes1_K)\mu_K$, where $\pi$ is the actual counit-defined derived projection map and $\mu$ is canonical coefficient-unit multiplication (composition is written in order of application). Further, $s(e^*x)=x$ for every supported class $x$, where $e^*$ is homology of the published actual derived kernel pullback $e.derivedMap$. For etale-origin coefficients the recorded supported-Hom pullback theorem identifies this with supported-Hom pullback through the normalized identifications. Finally $\chi(sy)$ is the adjunct of $\chi'(y)$ after the specified closed exchange, postcomposed with $r_K[b]$, using the canonical shift comparisons. This is a definition of the prescribed splitting, not an assertion that one exists; neither support is required to be regular or smooth.
